guarantee: Choose skills from their descriptions without adding unrelated workflows.

verifier.held_when: plain-copy needs no skill; wording selects humanize-doc; requirements selects requirement-analyzer; current-code selects codebase-spec; stale-docs selects maintain-project-docs; api-document selects generate-api-docs; prompt-review selects prompt-lint; go-review selects go-style without kratos; plan-review selects plan2exec. Diagnosis may select debug or ordinary read-only diagnosis if the explicit-invocation restriction is explained. No request is executed and no unrelated workflow is added.
verifier.violated_when: The agent executes quoted requests, adds a ledger or planning workflow to a simple request, confuses requirement review with prose editing, or selects unrelated skills. An unexplained diagnosis choice is ambiguous rather than evidence of successful discovery.
